display_projection: Canada Atlas Lambert (standard parallels 49° and 77°, central meridian 95°W)
storage: A gzip-compressed GeoJSON collection stores each polygon once. Its regionViews foreign member gives the per-year region properties and polygon indexes. The app reconstructs and downloads ordinary per-year GeoJSON.

earlier_maps.processing: Reference panels retained; active maps are generalized authored vector reconstructions. See colonial-digitization.json.

expanded_edition.act_of_union: Digital view of the union effective 1841; Oregon joint occupation and unsettled northeastern frontier. The 1849 image is reference only.
expanded_edition.before_1600: Modern geographic context. No invented Indigenous polygons or European colonial colours.
expanded_edition.nwt: 1912–1998 display one Northwest Territories label over retained historical district colours and boundaries. Districts are administrative, not separate territories.
expanded_edition.early_digital_maps: colonial-boundaries.json.gz stores shared coordinate indexes; the app reconstructs ordinary per-year GeoJSON.
